description: This file contains a PHP class named ProductPurchased which extends the base Model class within the OpenCart system. The class provides methods to retrieve purchase data and total purchased counts, including filtering based on order status, date ranges, and pagination options.

classes.name: ProductPurchased
classes.description: A model class for retrieving product purchase data within the OpenCart admin extension, enabling stats like most purchased products and total counts with filtering options.

methods.name: getPurchased
methods.description: Retrieves a list of purchased products with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalPurchased
methods.description: Calculates the total number of unique products purchased, with filtering options applied.
